full_lineup: Crime Boss: Rockay City - First Month Edition
discrepancies: Announced lineup was 8 games; Moonstone Island was added to the bundle mid-month (confirmed by ITAD and barter.vg) and is absent from the DB — likely claimed before the addition or unredeemed. Wreckfest appears on barter.vg only as a regional substitute (China) and is not part of the standard lineup. DB's 'Atlas Fallen' + 'Reign of Sand DLC' rows correspond to the single bundle item 'Atlas Fallen: Reign of Sand'; DB's 'Crime Boss: Rockay City' was the First Month Edition. The Boot.dev 1 Month Subscription perk (present in DB, excluded here) was a non-game bonus item. Tier-2 content was DLC discount vouchers only (Old World DLC, Bomb Rush Cyberfunk DLC).
